Heads Up! is an album by American trumpeter Blue Mitchell recorded in 1967 and released on the Blue Note label.[2]

Reception

[edit]
Professional ratings
Review scores
SourceRating
Allmusic[3]

The Allmusic review awarded the album 3 stars.[3]
